statistic <- c(corrected = sum((absolute_errors - correction)^2 / expected), uncorrected = sum(absolute_errors^2 / expected))
p_value <- stats::pchisq(statistic, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
value <- rbind(statistic = statistic, p_value = p_value)
answer <- if (correction == 0.5 && statistic[1] < statistic[2] && p_value[1] > p_value[2]) "A" else NA_character_
